name: Protein Shaker
description: A plastic container is presented to you. It features the official congress logo and feels heavy in your hand. As you move it, you can hear a thick liquid splashing against the sides, releasing a faint scent of vanilla protein.
action: You shook the shaker so vigorously that even Jay Cutler gave an approving nod. The protein is perfectly mixed and ready to be served.

name: Paintbrush
description: A fine-tipped paintbrush is presented to you. Its wooden handle is smooth from years of use, and the bristles are soft yet firm, clearly designed for high-level artistic precision.
action: With graceful strokes, you begin applying paint to the canvas. Frank Zane poses patiently as a masterpiece is born under your hands.
